head: 14036d0a38f68be80d42e382dbc6855f22ebc09f
task: Drop LangChain in favour of LangGraph from the first agent, defer FastAPI, and clear stale items out of the contract
result: Verified the LangGraph question against the real package before deciding. Rewrote docs/CONTRACT.md: LangGraph replaces the two-framework plan, FastAPI deferred behind a named trigger, BitsAndBytes fallback removed, model name corrected, docker/ dropped, and two new rules added (a message must carry tool calls and tool results; a framework's message classes are not the project's domain language). Added two DECISIONS.md entries. Updated ROADMAP.md stages and candidates, README.md stack and architecture, docs/BACKLOG.md. pyproject: agent group is now langgraph, fastapi and uvicorn removed from the app group.
checks: uv sync --group app: fastapi, uvicorn, starlette, click removed; pytest -q: 42 passed; grep for stale LangChain/FastAPI/BitsAndBytes references: only intentional ones remain

head: 4c5663ab42a3e4ce4f40bfc2eebcf3da4d914822
task: Close the tool loop: let Message carry the assistant's own tool calls and drive one real call-tool-answer cycle through a minimal graph
result: Message now carries tool_calls and accepts them in place of content, so an assistant turn that only calls tools is representable; build_messages replays them on the wire with content null. Added app/tools (Tool, Toolbox, and list_files/read_file confined to a root passed in by the caller and checked after resolution) and app/agent/graph.py (StateGraph with model and tools nodes, an append reducer, and the project's own dataclasses as state). Ran the graph live against the endpoint: two tool iterations, 3.82 s. Installed the agent dependency group into the Windows venv.
checks: pytest -q: 72 passed (30 new); ruff check on the touched files: clean; one live two-iteration run against the vLLM endpoint
